description: Ministry of Defence  - Recommended List of Naval Personnel for the Award of the Armed Service Long Service Medal & Clasp - 2019
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal & Clasp to military personnel. This falls under public service matters as it concerns service recognition and awards for members of the armed forces, which is a public sector service administration function. The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with portfolios, or any of the specialized categories like land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
